decisionSummary: Bureau Contacts 0.17.0 is a remediation cut for an owner-filed runtime diagnostic bundle (melusina-test-diagnostics, 2026-08-22). The defect, the measurement that identified it, and the mutation-proven guard that keeps it fixed are recorded in the commit message on this exact dev-publish tip. Main remains the reviewed baseline; the dev-publish head is the release authority, as for every other row in this catalog.

checks: clean detached checkout at the selected canonical dev-publish commit
go test ./... passes across all 3 packages including the release cohort guard
structured vCard N is stored, encoded and decoded; a round trip preserves given/additional/family, and the legacy first-space split is reached only for a contact with no structured parts
three mutations fail by name: unconditional legacy split, dropped N: decode case, and a model field that never reaches SQLite

the country catalogue is the estate's own identity.countries v1.0.0 vendored as generated Go, checked for uniqueness and ordering, with unrecognised free text reported as unmatched so the form keeps it verbatim
